name: Mercenary Summon Gargoyle
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Summon Gargoyle (players/warlock/mercenary/summon_gargoyle_merc.sval, 18 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): mana 75 (90). Its own mana 75 (90), cooldown 0.5 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Summon Gargoyle as at level 4 (32 magical bolts, 5 s, 50% static link, up to 5) for 75 mana.
